title: The exceptional chart equation detects global invertibility
statement: In the standing smooth pure-dimensional finite-type field setting, fix the two coefficient adjunctions and realizations [def-sp-reduction-exceptional-realization-objects]. A natural transformation c between their scalar/right composites whose components satisfy ReductionExceptionalChartEquation is componentwise an isomorphism on intrinsic Dctf.

source.place: Locality paragraph and retained Step 13: conservative finite coordinate cover

proof.text: Choose one common annihilator ell^(r+s) from the two ell-primary witnesses. Choose the ordinary normalized P1 data and compact-support normalizations. The field hypotheses make X and Y Noetherian.

Use a finite admissible coordinate cover of X. Compose each chart map with the inverse ordered-affine-space isomorphism to obtain a chart over the exact ordered affine tower. The chart equation expresses the restriction of c, conjugated by isomorphisms, as a composite of scalar, site and Tate reassociation isomorphisms. Cancel the endpoint isomorphisms to prove that each restricted component is invertible.

Transport the ambient component through the intrinsic equivalence to the fixed-module derived category. The canonical realization/pullback comparison carries the already proved local invertibility to this component. Complete it to a distinguished triangle. Pullback makes the cone zero on the open cover, so open-cover conservativity makes it zero globally. The distinguished-triangle isomorphism criterion proves the ambient component invertible; reflect through the equivalence and the full inclusion.
